## Eastern Bering

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="80%"}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)

region <- 'EasternBering'

colors <- list(
  ice_free  = '#d0e8f5',
  new_young = '#74b3d8',
  thin_FY   = '#2a7db5',
  medium_FY = '#1a5a8a',
  thick_FY  = '#0d3b5e',
  multiyear = '#051f30'
)

labels <- list(
  ice_free  = 'Ice Free',
  new_young = 'New/Young (<0.3m)',
  thin_FY   = 'Thin FY (0.3–0.7m)',
  medium_FY = 'Medium FY (0.7–1.2m)',
  thick_FY  = 'Thick FY (1.2–2.0m)',
  multiyear = 'Multi-year (>2.0m)'
)

cat_cols <- c('multiyear','thick_FY','medium_FY','thin_FY','new_young','ice_free')

# Load data
df_area <- read_csv('./data/EasternBering_sit_daily_ts.csv') |>
  mutate(time = as_datetime(time))

# Normalize x-axis to a reference year
# Oct-Dec → 2000, Jan-Apr → 2001 (fake year for alignment)
normalize_time <- function(df) {
  df |> mutate(
    time_norm = case_when(
      month(time) >= 10 ~ update(time, year = 2000),
      TRUE              ~ update(time, year = 2001)
    )
  )
}

# Filter and normalize seasons
df_2425 <- df_area |>
  filter(
    (year(time) == 2024 & month(time) %in% c(10,11,12)) |
    (year(time) == 2025 & month(time) %in% c(1,2,3,4))
  ) |>
  normalize_time()

df_2526 <- df_area |>
  filter(
    (year(time) == 2025 & month(time) %in% c(10,11,12)) |
    (year(time) == 2026 & month(time) %in% c(1,2,3,4))
  ) |>
  normalize_time()

# Helper to build one season plot
make_season_plot <- function(sdf, season, show_legend) {
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (cat in cat_cols) {
    p <- p |> add_trace(
      x             = sdf$time_norm,
      y             = sdf[[cat]],
      type          = 'scatter',
      mode          = 'lines',
      name          = labels[[cat]],
      legendgroup   = cat,
      showlegend    = show_legend,
      line          = list(width=0.5, color=colors[[cat]]),
      fillcolor     = colors[[cat]],
      stackgroup    = paste0(season, '_stack'),
      # Show real date in tooltip
      text          = format(sdf$time, '%b %d %Y'),
      hovertemplate = paste0(
        '<b>', season, '</b> ',
        labels[[cat]], ': %{y:,.0f} km²<extra></extra>'
      )
    )
  }
  p <- p |> layout(
    annotations = list(list(
      text      = season,
      x         = 0.01,
      y         = 0.95,
      xref      = 'paper',
      yref      = 'paper',
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font      = list(size=16, color='gray', family='Arial Black') 
    ))
  )
  p
}


# Build two plots
p1 <- make_season_plot(df_2425, '2024/25', show_legend = TRUE)
p2 <- make_season_plot(df_2526, '2025/26', show_legend = FALSE)

# Combine as subplot
fig <- subplot(
  p1, p2,
  nrows   = 2,
  shareX  = TRUE,
  titleY  = TRUE,
  heights = c(0.5, 0.5)
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text    = paste0(region, ' — Sea Ice Thickness (Oct - Apr)'),
      x       = 0.5,
      xanchor = 'center'
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = 'h',
      yanchor     = 'bottom',
      y           = 0.97,       # just below the title
      xanchor     = 'center',
      x           = 0.5
    ),

    yaxis = list(
      title  = 'Area (km²)'
   
    ),
    yaxis2 = list(
      title  = 'Area (km²)'

    ),

    xaxis = list(
      title      = 'Month',
      tickformat = '%b %d',   # show only month-day
      tickangle  = -45,
      dtick      = 'M1',
      xhoverformat = '%b %d'
    ),


    margin = list(l=80, t=150) ,
    hovermode = 'x unified',
    height   =     NULL,   
    autosize = TRUE
  
  )

fig
```
::::
:::
